parsed.body:
All [intruder] in each [corridorEW] move.
Then, all [intruder] in every Room move.

From each Room with a [fire],
spread [fire] to the neighboring
Rooms in Sections with [lifeSupportActive].

Each [character] makes a Noise roll.
